minimum_safe_ai_release.definition: Fastest viable production activation that restores Atlas IA with full academic safety, deterministic canonical grounding, and zero developer-machine dependency.
non_negotiable_invariants: Academic integrity preserved: 0 hallucinations on canonical anatomy
Sovereign memory dual residence: local git mirror remains root of truth
Security: 0 provider keys or tokens reach browser client
Provider replaceability: gateway abstracts underlying vendor SDKs

full_sovereign_ai_architecture.definition: Complete multi-provider sovereign architecture with dynamic multi-cloud failover, full-spectrum false-premise matrix, academic evidence mode drawer, and automated dual-residence sync.
deferred_features: Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet / OpenAI GPT-4o dynamic fallback routing
Generalized SemanticPremiseValidator across entire human body
Interactive Academic Evidence UI Drawer with deep locator viewer
Automated GitHub Action syncing canonical releases to Supabase tables

phases.name: Safe Engine & Canonical Memory Cloud Runtime Port
phases.goal: Port the deterministic Safe Engine from Node-fs to pure ESM for Deno Edge compatibility, package Canonical Memory 0.2.2 as an in-memory module, and eliminate all localhost/fs dependencies.
key_tasks: Replace import { performance } from 'perf_hooks' with global performance
Package Canonical Memory 0.2.2 (231 safe facts, 154 entities, practical memory, teaching connections) into a static ESM bundle
Refactor safeKnowledgeRetriever.js and safeEntityResolver.js to consume in-memory data instead of fs.readFileSync
Decouple node:sqlite from runtime retrieval; retain as offline verification tool
Execute Safe Engine contract test suite verifying 100% parity against baseline
entry_gates: Memory 0.2.2 intact: 248 facts, 154 entities, 231 safe facts

phases.name: Cloud Gateway Deployment & Edge Function Pipeline Integration
phases.goal: Deploy the containerized Aeternum AI Gateway to managed cloud infrastructure in cloud_only mode, wire the portable Safe Engine into supabase/functions/ai-tutor, and implement deterministic short-circuiting.
key_tasks: Deploy Docker container from packages/aeternum-vita/apps/gateway/Dockerfile to cloud host (Render / Cloud Run) with AETERNUM_AI_GATEWAY_MODE=cloud_only
Configure cloud secrets (GEMINI_API_KEY, AETERNUM_AI_GATEWAY_TOKEN) in container and Supabase Edge Function
Update supabase/functions/ai-tutor/index.ts to import portable Safe Engine
Implement short-circuit logic: return deterministic Safe Engine answers instantly; forward complex synthesis queries to Cloud Gateway
Harden error handling and fallback: return DEGRADED_DETERMINISTIC if gateway is unreachable
entry_gates: Gateway Docker build passes: npm run build:gateway

phases.name: End-to-End Staging Validation & Adversarial Testing
phases.goal: Deploy updated Edge Function to Staging Supabase (hutohshswppahipgcwio), connect Vercel staging, and execute a comprehensive verification test suite covering deterministic answers, synthesis, false premises, and load.
key_tasks: Deploy Edge Function to Staging Supabase: supabase functions deploy ai-tutor --project-ref hutohshswppahipgcwio
Configure Staging Vercel env: VITE_ATLAS_AI_MODE=live, VITE_ATLAS_RUNTIME=cloud
Run automated test matrix against staging: 20 canonical queries, 10 socratic synthesis queries, 5 false-premise probes, 5 out-of-scope probes
Verify zero calls to localhost, 127.0.0.1, :8081, or :8082 in staging network traces
Validate telemetry emission to ai_messages and ai_audit_events

phases.name: Controlled Production Promotion & Live Activation
phases.goal: Deploy verified Edge Function to Production Supabase (hyivyrietgjdazgizafp), switch VITE_ATLAS_AI_MODE to live on production Vercel domains, and perform post-activation health audit.
key_tasks: Verify production preflight gates and confirm rollback anchor dpl_vvHtzke37a52oqRrSxJQZ5grN4jM
Deploy Edge Function to Production Supabase: supabase functions deploy ai-tutor --project-ref hyivyrietgjdazgizafp
Update Vercel Production environment variable: VITE_ATLAS_AI_MODE=live
Trigger production redeployment on Vercel without cache
Execute live production smoke test on https://www.aeternumatlas.com
